text:
maya: Quick experiment thought for the pricing calculator: add a tiny inline 'next step' strip after results with 3 choices: Demo / Webinar / Continue. Capture intent without a modal.

leo: Good — keep it inline and keyboard accessible. Pills only, no extra page load.

jamie: Copy tests: two headlines to AB: 'See a tailored plan' vs 'Lower per-token spend'. CTAs: 'Book a demo' vs 'Talk to sales'.

nina: Routing: Sales wants leads >= $1.5k routed to SDR webhook. Add is_enterprise_candidate boolean and preferred_cta_label in payload. Mask prompt data.

leo: UX: show one-line FAQ snippet when Demo is selected (e.g., 'Reserved capacity includes SLA & priority support'). Keep link to full FAQ.

jamie: Analytics: fire one event per session or on CTA click. Example: window.dataLayer.push({ event: 'pricing_next_step', path: 'demo|webinar|self', estimate_usd: 2100, exp_id: 'exp_pricing_strip_23' });

dev-bot: experiment created: exp_pricing_strip_23. Staging deploy scheduled.

sales-ops: Confirmed. We'll accept webhook shape and threshold. Please include session_id + utm in events.

maya: Timeline: mock today, spec tomorrow, dev by end of week, 10% rollout next Tue. I'll update the experiment doc with KPIs.
